class.label: Compound-v2 fork empty cToken market exchange-rate inflation via 1-wei mint plus donation

remediation.summary: Enforce a non-trivial initial-seed-deposit (held by the protocol or burned) for every newly listed cToken market before borrowing is enabled. Either bake the seed requirement into market-listing, or use OpenZeppelin's ERC4626-style virtual-shares offset to make donation inflation infeasible.
